coordinate_convention: Source schema defines start/end character indices and annotation evidence as indices into document.spans. Primary comparison uses start-inclusive/end-exclusive Python character slices, matching frozen source receipts and prior source mapping. The locally cached official schema does not explicitly spell end exclusivity; an end+1 sensitivity is included without resolving that uncertainty by assumption.
limitations: Annotated spans may omit qualifications, definitions or other context needed for semantic sufficiency; full annotated-span coverage does not prove semantic sufficiency or identify the head as the sole cause.
Partial annotation coverage is a concrete context omission under the stated coordinate convention; it does not show that omitted evidence would change the classifier output.
All native top40 returned units are measured as retrieval candidates before context packing. No rank outside the returned top40 is invented. Entire indexed partition coverage is reported separately.
No inference, fitting, calibration, thresholds, source/gold/scorer/gate changes, new choices or confirmation consumption. Source text is not quoted.
selected_case_rule: Only the four contradiction-gold cases already present in sealed scorer-result.json; this is posthoc outcome-conditioned description, never candidate selection or qualification.
source_annotation_read_scope: One source parse inspected only selected annotations spans fields for these four cases and mapped their indices to the document spans arrays. No source choice values or other annotations/roles were read. Existing extracted indices/offsets are reused here without parsing source again.
